crossRefs.note: The man answered them, “How amazing! You don’t know where he comes from, yet he opened my eyes.
He answered them, “He who made me well said to me, ‘Take up your mat and walk.’”
He who believes in the Son of God has the testimony in himself. He who doesn’t believe God has made him a liar, because…

translations.web: He therefore answered, “I don’t know if he is a sinner. One thing I do know: that though I was blind, now I see.”
translations.bsb: He answered, “Whether He is a sinner I do not know. There is one thing I do know: I was blind, but now I see!”
translations.kjv: He answered and said, Whether he be a sinner or no, I know not: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.
translations.asv: He therefore answered, Whether he is a sinner, I know not: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.
